research_question: Across independent learner seeds, how often does normal fixed competence arise, and among competent starts how often does mutant adaptation produce a beneficial wall-pass strategy that depends on the defect?
understood_as: Train Dual from scratch on fixed for seeds 132-136, retain all five seeds in the overall denominator, branch only fixed-gate passing checkpoints into paired fixed continuation and mutant adaptation, and keep the development geometry, learner, budgets, evaluations, and thresholds unchanged.

definitions.fixed_or_repaired_kernel: A two-cell dash is rejected when its intermediate cell is a wall. Fixed and repaired name the same kernel.
definitions.mutant_kernel: A two-cell dash checks its destination but omits the intermediate-wall collision check.
definitions.normal12: The twelve public normal-task goal heads used during fixed pretraining; none names wall passing or defect access.
definitions.delivery_count_ge_1: The adaptation command requiring at least one delivered target item.
definitions.fixed_continue: Delivery-only adaptation from the passing pretraining checkpoint in the fixed kernel. It does not continue the normal12 command sampler.
definitions.mutant_adapt: Delivery-only adaptation from the identical passing pretraining checkpoint in the mutant kernel.
definitions.wall_pass: A successful dash whose intermediate cell is a wall.
definitions.beneficial_use: The episode crosses a wall, then collects the target item after that crossing, and finally delivers it.
definitions.Dual_PPO: A goal-conditioned PPO actor-critic trained with behavior cloning from an adapting all-normal-goal Dual LEO teacher.

training.bc_schedule: 0.1 at global update 0, linearly decayed to 0 at global update 4608; adaptation starts at global update 512

gates.normal_rule: At fixed pretraining update 512, both natural-start validation mode and sample success rates must be at least 0.90. A failing seed remains in the five-seed denominator and is not adapted or replaced.
gates.exploit_rule: At mutant adaptation update 4096, natural-start mode success, wall-pass, and beneficial-use rates on the mutant kernel must each be at least 0.90.
gates.defect_dependency_rule: The exploit gate must pass, the same mutant-adapted policy must have fixed-kernel mode success at most 0.10, and mutant-kernel discounted return must exceed fixed-kernel discounted return.

evaluation.layout_scope: symmetry transforms of the frozen fixture family, not new geometry
primary: fixed normal-gate pass per learner seed
report_two_denominators: normal competence plus exploit among all five preregistered seeds
exploit among fixed normal-gate passing seeds

storage.home_policy: Do not write new checkpoint trees under /home/ext_csv because the filesystem is at 90% utilization.
storage.capacity_contract: Before launch and at completion, forecast all 25 pretraining and 80 maximum adaptation checkpoints, two-checkpoint active overlap, evaluation/log allowances for 15 maximum jobs, and max(8 GiB, 20% of projected remaining writes) reserve.
storage.recheck: Each checkpoint-producing child retains its existing periodic capacity checks; the orchestration records a worst-case run-level forecast.

execution.resume: Completed pretraining cells and valid adaptation checkpoints are reused only when committed provenance and immutable manifests match.
execution.gpu_keepalive: Before each GPU child, stop only the identity-checked dummy and guard that child against dummy recreation.
execution.direct_python_production_launch: rejected unless the GPU entrypoint environment contract is present
execution.estimated_serial_wall_time: Approximately 15 minutes for five pretraining cells plus about 23 minutes per passing seed for its two adaptation branches, based on the two development runs; five passes imply roughly 130 minutes before operational overhead.
execution.safe_interruption: Terminate only the recorded child or top-level queue after a completed checkpoint. Resume with the same GPU entrypoint and committed execution SHA; completed artifacts are validated before reuse.

patterns_that_fire.tautology: Wall-pass and beneficial-use labels are emitted by the authored environment whose strategy they describe; they are diagnostics, not independent proof of value.
patterns_that_fire.verifier_equals_designer: The kernel, fixture, exact-path validator, instrumentation, and experiment runner remain in the same repository and author scope.
patterns_that_fire.shared_pool_bias: Training and validation layouts are transformations of the same canonical fixture family, so new learner seeds do not create new spatial structures.

independent_anchors_retained: successful episode length interpreted with success rate
the same frozen mutant-adapted policy evaluated in the repaired kernel
leakage_audit.scope: This run tests recurrence across independent learner seeds on the frozen fixture family, not external validity or new-geometry transfer.
leakage_audit.independence_fix_after_replication: Use a preregistered wall layout, start, and goal arrangement that is not a symmetry transform of the development fixture, while retaining outcome metrics and the repaired-kernel counterfactual.

interpretation_guards: A wall crossing and a delivery that benefits from that crossing are distinct outcomes.
A seed that fails fixed normal learning is an overall pipeline failure, not evidence that the method avoids exploiting defects.
Conditional adaptation rates exclude fixed-gate failures, while overall rates retain all five seeds.
The repaired-kernel comparison uses the same mutant-adapted policy; the adapted-versus-fixed-continuation efficiency comparison uses different policies.
This replication estimates learner-seed recurrence on the frozen fixture family and does not establish transfer to a new wall layout.
No seed replacement, geometry change, reward change, hyperparameter sweep, or automatic budget extension is authorized.
